request.acceptance_criteria: The Hegel CLI properties and the Bombadil TUI properties run in CI (Bombadil job may be separate); each property was shown to fail against a seeded bug; the report lists real bugs found
request.description: Planned 2026-09-27 as notes on 8v3 and 2jn (both now closed, so it was never filed); unblocked since r6w put the toolchain on Go ≥1.26 (Hegel needs it). CLI with Hegel (hegel-go, stateful where useful): for generated argument sequences and run states — every --json command emits one document valid against its versioned schema; the exit code is always one from the documented table and agrees with the document's state word; --json never writes to stderr; flags parse in any order (#75's remedy rule). TUI with Bombadil (@antithesishq/bombadil, terminal driver) over 89m's ticfac watch and 2qz's bare ticfac overview, driven by fixture registries/feeds: a stale or orphaned run never shows as live (today's phantom 'running — in phase plan' cloud runs); a registry entry whose checkout is gone never shows (#86); every held or failed run shows the one command that clears it; history collapses into one line (#87); the first frame appears within its bound (#112). Browser driver for i1r's phone page if cheap. Load hegel-skill for the Hegel half. End with a short report of what the properties found.
request.title: Property-test the ticfac CLI and TUI: Hegel for --json/exit codes, Bombadil for watch and the overview
